good.label: Good
good.advice: Air quality is satisfactory; enjoy outdoor activities.
good.alert_message: The hourly AQI is good. Suitable for all outdoor activities.

moderate.label: Moderate
moderate.advice: Sensitive people should reduce strenuous outdoor activity.
moderate.alert_message: The hourly AQI is moderate. Sensitive people should reduce strenuous outdoor activity.

usg.label: Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups
usg.advice: Sensitive groups should limit time outdoors and wear a mask; everyone should reduce strenuous outdoor activity.
usg.alert_message: The hourly AQI is unhealthy for sensitive groups. Children, older adults and people with respiratory disease should limit time outdoors.

unhealthy.label: Unhealthy
unhealthy.advice: Everyone should avoid strenuous outdoor activity, close windows and wear a particle-filtering mask outdoors.
unhealthy.alert_message: The hourly AQI is unhealthy. Limit time outdoors.

very_unhealthy.label: Very Unhealthy
very_unhealthy.advice: Everyone should avoid outdoor activities, keep windows closed and run an air purifier if available.
very_unhealthy.alert_message: The hourly AQI is very unhealthy. Avoid outdoor activities.

hazardous.label: Hazardous
hazardous.advice: Everyone should stay indoors and avoid all outdoor activities.
hazardous.alert_message: The hourly AQI is hazardous. Stay indoors and keep windows closed.

errors.RANGE_TOO_LARGE: Time range is too long for resolution {resolution} (maximum {max_days} days).
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests, please try again later.
errors.SSE_LIMIT: Too many realtime connections; live updates are paused.
